description.narrative: The project will upgrade and maintain over 450 kilometers of state roads forming part of the core road network in Maharashtra, which will enhance transport accessibility and efficiency, and improve the safety of the road network, in line with the state's Road Development Plan 2001-2021. It will involve upgrading state roads to a two-lane standard and performance-based maintenance contracts to maintain the improved road assets for 5 years after construction. It also includes initiatives to build institutional capacity within the Public Works Department, Government of Maharashtra, focusing on improved road safety.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3911: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 19 Jun 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Works: Of the 9 contracts for work packages, 7 were awarded and mobilized before the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic while the remaining 2 work packages were mobilized in September 2020. As of September 2023, contractors have achieved an average physical progress of 98.87%, with seven complete packages and two packages near completion. Consulting: All three original consulting packages, two consulting firms as authority engineers and one consulting firm for project management services (PMS), were mobilized in 2020 and in February 2021, respectively. The contract of the additional consulting package for the core road network master plan was awarded in 2022.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Dec 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52298/52298-001-apfs-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Nov 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52298/52298-001-rp-en.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Aug 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52298/52298-001-smr-en_7.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The contractors achieved an average physical progress of 98.87% as of September 2023. Out of the 9 contracts for civil works packages, 7 packages have been completed (EPCs 1, 2, 3, 5, 6,7 and 9). Road safety features have been incorporated in the design of the roads. The PMS Consultant has completed the road safety audit for the selected 200 kms of roads. Training on (i) gender action plan: gender sensitization, (ii) environmental safeguards, (iii) road safety, and (iv) climate change have been conducted. Preparation of the Road Network Master Plan is in progress.
